name: The Burning
summary: The Ashfound's first order: burn a Choir shrine in the Shards with a forge charge and report it burned. They start with the singing.

pyre.summary: Forge-master Hesk has marked a Choir shrine in the Shards and forged the charge. Burn it.

objectives.text: Burn the marked Choir shrine in a Shard

report.summary: Report the burning to Forge-master Hesk in the forge.

objectives.text: Report to Forge-master Hesk in the Ashfound forge

done.summary: Burned, and it stayed burned. The Marshal wants a Key next: the Choir's own, under the Null Cathedral's fringe where the fonts go quiet.
